# mplay32.exe is all Rust (mplay32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mplay32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# mplay32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mplay32-rust/src/mplay32/mplay32.rs)
add_cargo_module(mplay32 mplay32-cargo mplay32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mplay32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
